snippet.title: [ARCADE] King Of Boxer(Ring King)
snippet.description:
Ring King(1985, Data East) - Arcade longplay/walkthrough

Ring King, known as King of Boxer in Japan and Europe, is an arcade boxing game. It was published in 1985 by Woodplace in Japan and Europe, and by Data East in North America.
